body:
Known issues: these open `P1` and `P2` issues are not on the cut list. Their fixes ship in the next minor. `RELEASE_NOTES.md` lists them too.

- #3699 (P1): Mill posts fanuc, doosan-dnm, mazak, sinumerik, tormach, linuxcnc: the G84 tap feed is rounded to a whole mm/min
- #3339 (P2): Start and exit points: move the picks to one operation-level project key
- #3336 (P2): Performance: the stock simulation is very slow - it runs on the CPU, the GPU shader path is not built
- #3334 (P2): Start and exit points: Plasma Profile and the future waterjet kinds (pierce point and cancel point)
- #3333 (P2): Start and exit points: Sinker Burn and Sinker Side Burn (start and end of the orbit and the side move)
- #3332 (P2): Start and exit points: Wire Contour (threading point into the shared pick, exit on open runs)
- #3331 (P2): Start and exit points: turning kinds (start in the Z-X plane)
- #3330 (P2): Start and exit points: multi-axis kinds (5-axis, swarf, rotary, flow, multi-axis rough and contour)
- #3329 (P2): Start and exit points: 3D kinds (3D Pocket, 3D Finish, Deburr)
- #3328 (P2): Start and exit points: drilling order (Drill, Bore, Thread mill - first hole and last hole)
- #3327 (P2): Start and exit points: 2D Adaptive (entry of the first pass, end of the last pass)
- #3326 (P2): Start and exit points: Face raster (first row corner, last row end)
- #3325 (P2): Start and exit points: 2D ring and chain kinds (Pocket, Offset, Circular, Slot, Trochoidal slot, Trace, Engrave, Chamfer)
- #2629 (P2): GPU stock sim S3: viewport playback cuts on the GPU, with CPU fallback
- #1473 (P2): Start and exit points: exit points, viewport pick, and the cases the first contour slice refuses
- #1448 (P2): Operations: user-set start and exit points, path regenerated to them
